meta.label: MOCK DATA — NOT VERIFIED
meta.disclaimer: Every record on this screen is synthetic demonstration data created for the vertical slice. It is not Shopee, TikTok, Facebook or market evidence, and no commission, conversion, order or net-income figure is real.
meta.measurementPolicy: OQ-8 is unresolved: per-program commission field semantics are not verified against an authorised dashboard. Net income is therefore reported as NOT_YET_MEASURABLE, never as zero and never as a forecast.

opportunities.title: Compact desk cable organiser
opportunities.audience: Office workers and students in Thailand with limited desk space
opportunities.problem: Charging cables fall behind the desk and are hard to reach during the workday
opportunities.whyNow: Desk-setup content is cheap to produce and the product is easy to demonstrate in a short video

confidence.reason: Demand is inferred from synthetic search notes only; no first-party traffic or conversion data exists yet

measurement.reason: No dashboard access, and OQ-8 field semantics are unverified

evidence.finding: Listing states a price of THB 590 and a seller commission rate of 5%.
evidence.relevance: Sets the two numbers used in the illustrative arithmetic
evidence.limitations: Synthetic listing; a real rate is visible only in the affiliate dashboard

evidence.finding: The category is not on the synthetic excluded-category list used by this demo.
evidence.relevance: Suggests the offer is commissionable, subject to the real program terms
evidence.limitations: Derived from a mock list; the official Shopee terms must be checked before G2

evidence.finding: A Facebook Page with a profile link is treated as available for this demo.
evidence.relevance: Determines whether the planned link form can actually be used
evidence.limitations: Account eligibility was not checked; this is an assumption, not a finding

analysis.hypothesis: A 30-second desk-reset video on a Facebook Page can produce at least one affiliate order within 14 days.
analysis.resultNote: Illustrative arithmetic only. It is not a forecast, not expected income, and not a measured commission.
risks: Traffic and conversion assumptions are unverified
Per-post clicks may be unavailable, leaving attribution UNKNOWN
Facebook link affordances depend on the account, which was not checked

confidence.reason: Two of the four terms are pure assumptions and the channel claim is UNKNOWN

brief.rationale: The product is visually demonstrable, cheap to film, and has no evident category exclusion in the mock data.
uncertainties: Whether the Facebook Page can carry a clickable bio link
Whether the seller rate shown is the rate paid to an affiliate
Whether clicks can be attributed to this post at all

proposedExperiment.offer: Cable organiser, one seller, one listing
proposedExperiment.successCriteria: At least one order recorded against the affiliate link within 14 days (commission status remains unverified)

opportunities.title: Thai herbal balm gift set
opportunities.audience: Office workers buying small gifts for colleagues
opportunities.problem: Useful, locally made gifts are hard to choose quickly at a low price point
opportunities.whyNow: Gift content performs around paydays and local holidays; the product is inexpensive to ship

confidence.reason: Seasonality and price fit are plausible from synthetic notes, but no demand data was measured

measurement.reason: No dashboard access; commission semantics remain unverified

evidence.finding: Listing states a price of THB 320 and a seller commission rate of 8%.
evidence.relevance: Supplies the price and rate used in the illustrative arithmetic
evidence.limitations: Synthetic listing; real rates are campaign-specific

evidence.finding: Synthetic note suggests gift searches rise near month-end paydays.
evidence.relevance: Timing signal for when to publish
evidence.limitations: Pattern is asserted, not measured; it is a hypothesis to test

evidence.finding: Synthetic policy note says commercial content should carry a disclosure label.
evidence.limitations: The real channel policy has not been verified; treat as unconfirmed

analysis.hypothesis: A gift-guide post can produce at least two orders in the 14-day window.
analysis.resultNote: Illustrative arithmetic only, not a forecast or a record of earnings.
risks: Seasonality may vanish after the payday window
Gift content may attract clicks without purchases

confidence.reason: Plausible price and timing, but demand and disclosure are unverified

brief.rationale: Low price point and a clear gifting use case make this easier to explain than a technical product.
uncertainties: Whether the payday pattern is real
Whether the seller rate applies to affiliates

proposedExperiment.offer: Herbal balm gift set, one seller, one listing
proposedExperiment.successCriteria: At least two orders recorded against the affiliate link within 14 days

opportunities.title: Minimal silver pendant
opportunities.problem: Everyday jewellery is hard to compare online without clear sizing
opportunities.whyNow: Accessory content is visual and short to produce

confidence.reason: Category appears excluded from commission in the mock policy note, which undermines the business case

measurement.reason: No dashboard access; and the offer may be ineligible for commission

evidence.finding: Listing states a price of THB 890 and a seller commission rate of 10%.
evidence.relevance: Shows an attractive rate that must be checked against eligibility

evidence.finding: Jewellery is listed as an excluded category that earns no commission.
evidence.relevance: Directly contradicts the commercial case for this offer
evidence.limitations: Synthetic note modelled on the official Shopee excluded-category FAQ; re-verify before acting

evidence.finding: Synthetic note suggests accessory return rates are higher than average.
evidence.relevance: Return risk would affect any commission that did accrue

analysis.hypothesis: Jewellery content can earn commission within 14 days.
analysis.resultNote: The arithmetic is shown only to demonstrate that an attractive headline rate is irrelevant when the category is ineligible. It is not a forecast.
risks: Category exclusion makes the offer non-commissionable
No evidence that the audience buys jewellery from short video

confidence.reason: A verified exclusion outweighs the attractive headline rate

brief.rationale: The headline rate is attractive, but the mock category rule appears to exclude jewellery from commission entirely.
uncertainties: Whether the exclusion applies to this specific sub-category
Whether returns would erase any commission that did accrue
